headword: {住宅展示場|じゅうたくてんじじょう}
reading: じゅうたくてんじじょう

definitions.explanation: A site where several house builders each put up a full-size model home so that people planning to build can tour them and compare designs, often on weekends with the family.

examples.japanese: {住宅展示場|じゅうたくてんじじょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: To go to a model-home park.

examples.japanese: ⟦{週末|しゅうまつ}→週末：03030_shuumatsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{住宅展示場|じゅうたくてんじじょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}て→見る：00283_miru⟧⟦{回|まわ}った→回る：01150_mawaru⟧。
examples.english: We spent the weekend looking around a model-home park.

examples.japanese: ⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{建|た}てる→建てる：01189_tateru⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、{住宅展示場|じゅうたくてんじじょう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧いくつ⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦メーカー→メーカー：11158_meekaa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{比|くら}べた→比べる：01237_kuraberu⟧。
examples.english: Before building our house, we compared the homes of several builders at a housing exhibition park.

notes:
Built from ⟦{住宅|じゅうたく}→住宅：03280_juutaku⟧ (housing) and {展示場|てんじじょう} (exhibition ground). Each house on the site is a ⟦モデルハウス→モデルハウス：33988_moderuhausu⟧; sales staff show visitors around and take down details, so a first visit often leads to follow-up calls.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
